camel_example: aliyun devops GET /repository/2709413/tag/list --region cn-hangzhou --organizationId 611b75680fc7bf0dbe1dce55 --search Demo --pageSize 10 --page 2 --sort updated_desc --accessToken f0b1e61db5961df5975a93f9129d2513 --header "Content-Type=application/json"
description_zh: 查询代码库的标签（Tag）列表
name: ListRepositoryTags

parameters.help_en: The organization ID. Get this ID from the URL of your organization page in Alibaba Cloud DevOps. Example: https\://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}
parameters.help_zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
parameters.name: organization_id

parameters.help_en: The personal access token. This parameter is not required if you use an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pair or temporary authorization with STS
parameters.help_zh:
个人访问令牌。
使用阿里云AK+SK或使用STS临时授权方式不需要传该字段
parameters.name: access_token

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages are numbered starting from 1. Defaults to 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码 
默认值为1，从第1页开始
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The page size. Defaults to 20. Range: 1–100
parameters.help_zh:
每页大小
默认值为20，取值范围【1,100】
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Defaults to updated\_desc.

- updated\_asc: Update time, ascending

- updated\_desc: Update time, descending

- name\_asc: Tag name, ascending

- name\_desc: Tag name, descending
parameters.help_zh:
排序方式，默认值为updated_desc
- updated_asc：更新时间，升序
- updated_desc：更新时间，降序
- name_asc：标签名称，升序
- name_desc：标签名称，降序
parameters.name: sort

parameters.help_en: The search keyword to match against tag names
parameters.help_zh: 搜索关键字（匹配标签名称）
parameters.name: search
